subject.title: Fix silent provider-error retry after prior side effects

question: Should maintainers adopt this PR as the canonical fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/97877 after rebase and proof, or prefer another open candidate?
rationale: The code shape is plausible and avoids the unsafe broad guard removal, but the branch changes retry/session/harness contracts, conflicts with current main, and overlaps other open fix PRs.

options.title: Adopt this PR after rebase and proof
options.body: Require the contributor to resolve conflicts and add redacted full-runner or gateway proof showing retry recovery and no duplicate side effects, then continue review on this branch.

options.title: Prefer the other per-attempt candidate
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97966 as the canonical branch if its per-attempt delta implementation and live proof are judged stronger.

options.title: Pause all candidates for owner design
options.body: Hold the duplicate PRs open until an agent-runtime owner chooses the permanent harness result contract and provider retry ordering.

recommendation.title: Adopt this PR after rebase and proof
recommendation.body: Require the contributor to resolve conflicts and add redacted full-runner or gateway proof showing retry recovery and no duplicate side effects, then continue review on this branch.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history across the embedded runner, terminal retry semantics, and Codex harness compatibility surfaces touched by this decision.
